incident_name: MSC Chitra - Khalijia-3 collision / Mumbai oil spill
notes: Use as a historical validation and replay case for source attribution.
Sentinel-1 was not available in 2010, so SAR validation imagery for this incident must come from older missions such as ENVISAT ASAR, RADARSAT, TerraSAR-X, or official reports if accessible.
CDS/ERA5 can be used for wind reanalysis around the incident window, but ocean currents should come from Copernicus Marine or another ocean reanalysis product.

incident_name: GAL Constructor — grounding and oil spillage following Cyclone Tauktae
notes: Incident began May 17, 2021; Oil sheen observed May 29-30, 2021.
Fuel onboard: ~78k L HFHSD; Leakage: ~1k L; Recovered: ~79-80k L.
Cause: Cyclone Tauktae leading to anchor failure and grounding.
Location: Valrai Rocks / Vadrai coast, Palghar.
source_links: Official Directorate General of Shipping record
